label: Blind sample 058: Hansen forest loss 2020, tile 60N_100E

verdict.headline: Can't tell
verdict.statement: Greenness (NDVI) fell by 0.16 relative to the control trajectory in the 18 months after 1 Jan 2020 (90% interval −0.77 to +0.52). The same test was run on 60 untouched control cells. In 11 of them the no-event prediction missed by as much after the event date, relative to how closely it matched before, as it did here (placebo p = 0.20). Counted by gap size instead, 0 of the 60 moved at least as far as this area did in the same direction (p = 0.02). But: only 19 clear observation periods before the event (need 20).
reasons: only 19 clear observation periods before the event (need 20)

evidence.sentence: Neither optical nor radar shows a change beyond what the controls did.
